content.answer_markdown:
The latest Analysis Run (run 1) gives this Portfolio an overall suitability status of **breach**. Three of the seven rules flag it:

- **SR-02 Single-position limit (breach):** AAPL 15.0%, MSFT 14.99% and NVDA 12.01% are each above the 10% single-position limit.
- **SR-03 Sector concentration (breach):** Information Technology is 57.1% including look-through, against a 30% sector limit. AAPL, MSFT, NVDA and XLK are all technology exposure.
- **SR-04 Minimum cash reserve (warning):** Cash is 5.0%, which clears the 2% floor, but it is below the 6.4% liquidity needs.

The other four rules pass: maximum equity share, Client Restrictions (the Client has none), horizon check and taxable-gain warning.

The flags come from concentration and liquidity, not from drift. Every Asset Class is on target, so the Portfolio Drift is within tolerance.

claims.text: AAPL, MSFT and NVDA each carry a weight above the single-position limit, which is why SR-02 is a breach.
Cash is 5.0% of the Portfolio against 6.4% liquidity needs, so SR-04 is a warning.
